name: Jaú: Bahian Afro-Pop
description: Kick off the weekend with the infectious rhythms of Bahian Afro-pop in a relaxed and free concert setting.
longDescription:
On September 17, 2026, Jaú brings his Bahian Afro-Pop sound to the Casa da Música Cafe. Hailing from Bahia, Brazil, Jaú is known for blending traditional Afro-Brazilian rhythms with contemporary pop influences, creating a distinctive and danceable style. His music often features elements of samba-reggae, axé, and other regional genres, reflecting the diverse musical heritage of his home state.

Attendees can expect a lively and engaging performance in the intimate setting of the Casa da Música Cafe. The concert is free to attend and offers a relaxed atmosphere, suitable for an evening out. The performance is scheduled to begin at 21:30, providing an opportunity to enjoy live music in a casual environment.

This is a free event, with walk-ins welcome. The Casa da Música is located near the Casa da Música metro station, a 2-minute walk away. Several bus lines also serve the area. The venue is generally accessible.
